name: MAST-Data
description: MAST-Data is a comprehensive dataset of over 1600 annotated traces collected across multiple multi-agent system frameworks, designed to systematically identify and analyze failure patterns in multi-agent LLM systems using a novel failure taxonomy.
reputation: A newly introduced dataset for analyzing multi-agent LLM failures; promising for research but not yet broadly established as a community standard.
notes: Includes a Multi-Agent System Failure Taxonomy (MAST) with 14 failure modes; provides an LLM-as-a-Judge annotation pipeline.
